propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric only detects adjacent identical signatures and is blind to cycles of length k >= 2, so a genuine 4-call cycle scores 1 while healthy breadth with 5 adjacent repeats scores higher

a windowed distinct-ratio (set cardinality of trailing 24 signatures / 24) is order-insensitive and detects all cycle lengths, firing at distinct_ratio_window <= 0.50 while staying above 0.833 on healthy runs

_repetition_summary must be extended to compute and report distinct_ratio_window alongside existing counters, returning None when fewer than REPETITION_WINDOW signatures exist to prevent false positives on short sequences

REPETITION_WINDOW (24) and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO (0.50) must be exported as module-level named constants shared by the producer (usage_log) and three consumers (c827 actuator, aec1 recorder, and summary function)
